lastCompletedStory.title: Emit createdAt on cam issue list --json rows

nextStoryContext: US-001 added a required createdAt: string field to BacklogJsonRow (src/issues/list.ts) and toJsonRow now passes issue.createdAt through verbatim. Every BacklogJsonRow-shaped fixture/toEqual assertion across the codebase must include createdAt going forward. The human-readable cam issue list renderer (deriveBacklogView / BacklogViewEntry) was intentionally left untouched; the date column is still out of scope for the plain-text view. No schema or issue-file changes were made: issues.schema.json and scripts/cam/issues/* are unaffected by this story.
